pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with soft, feathered edge gradients. Patch shapes vary from elongated rectangles on the neck to more rounded quadrilaterals on the chest area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-neck, widening significantly at the ventral transition.
